entities.name: Iris
entities.description: The blind Oracle of Ephara of Meletis, whose gift of foresight comes from touch; she falls in love with her bodyguard Alexio.

entities.name: Alexio
entities.description: A winged Skyknight of Meletis assigned to escort Iris to the garrison at Soli; he dies holding off ambushers so she can escape.

entities.name: Perisophia
entities.description: The current head of the Twelve, the ruling council of philosophers of Meletis, who orders Iris moved to Soli.

entities.name: The Twelve
entities.description: The ruling council of philosophers of Meletis, meeting in the great hall of governance.

entities.name: Ambush Commander
entities.description: The leader of a patrol of rangers who hunts Iris and Alexio and scries their location in a golden goblet.

entities.name: Meletis
entities.description: The polis of philosophers where Iris serves as oracle and the Twelve govern.

entities.name: Soli
entities.description: A garrison where Iris is to be moved for safety.

entities.name: Temple of Ephara
entities.description: The temple where Iris spends most of her time in luxury.

entities.name: Ephara
entities.description: The god Iris serves as oracle; she prays to her for safety.

entities.name: Purphoros
entities.description: A god whose worshipers and renegade factions threaten to provoke war.

entities.name: Pegasus
entities.description: A pegasus friendly to the Skyguard whom Alexio finds as a mount and who carries Iris away.

events.summary: Iris refuses to hide, but Perisophia and the Twelve decide she must be moved to the garrison at Soli because enemy agents have infiltrated Meletis.
events.quote: We have conferred with the Temple and agreed that you will be moved to the garrison at Soli

events.summary: Alexio is presented as Iris's bodyguard; when she touches him she has a vision that he will fall in love with her and be taken from her, and resolves to prevent it.
events.quote: He was in love with her.

events.summary: Iris and Alexio leave Meletis at dawn on the overland route south through the forest.
events.quote: Perisophia let go of Iris's hand as Alexio led her horse away

events.summary: Iris gallops carelessly away from Alexio, and he swoops down and saves her from an ambush by two men he believes are worshipers of Purphoros; her horse is lamed and put down.
events.quote: Judging by the markings on their weapons, I would guess they were worshipers of Purphoros.

events.summary: Pursuers find the dead ambushers and the horse and track the Oracle and the Skyguard.
events.quote: Men, we will be home with our captive and the head of a Skyguard before the moon is full.

events.summary: Alexio brings a friendly pegasus as a mount, and Iris and Alexio fly toward the mountains.
events.quote: Hold fast, but know that he will not let you fall.

events.summary: A storm forces them to land and shelter in a mountain cave.
events.quote: Alexio led them into a cave on the side of the mountain.

events.summary: The commander scries their location in a golden goblet and plans to ambush them in the cave with the help of a spider of the upper forest.
events.quote: We will ambush them in the cave.

events.summary: Iris and Alexio become lovers in the cave, Iris deciding that she may be able to change his fate by loving him back.
events.quote: Before she could control herself, she felt his lips touch hers.

events.summary: Ambushers attack the cave; Alexio finds the back entrance blocked by a spider web and is shot while clearing it.
events.quote: Another arrow twanged through the cavern, this time finding its mark.

events.summary: Alexio sends Iris away on the pegasus and stays to fight, telling her he loves her; Iris senses he will die.
events.quote: She knew he would never make it out of that cave, his mighty body and heavenly wings doomed.

events.summary: Iris blames herself for Alexio's death and flies west toward freedom instead of to Soli or Meletis.
events.quote: The Oracle of Ephara flew blindly through the rain toward freedom, unseeing and alone, as she had always truly been.

relations.note: Perisophia is the current head of the Twelve.
relations.quote: said Perisophia, the current head of the ruling council of philosophers known as the Twelve.

relations.note: Iris is the Oracle of Ephara and lives in servitude to her god and polis.
relations.quote: Although she lived in servitude to her god and her polis

relations.note: Alexio is assigned as her bodyguard.
relations.quote: My duty is to see you safely to the garrison at Soli.

relations.note: They become lovers in the cave.
relations.quote: She tilted her head toward him and parted her lips.

relations.note: The commander's men hunt Iris and the Skyguard.
relations.quote: Men, we will be home with our captive and the head of a Skyguard before the moon is full.
